sentences.text:
Smt. Saroj Sharma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7
August, 2025

Author: Milind Ramesh Phadke
Bench: Milind Ramesh Phadke

Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Gwl:17921
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

On The 7 th Of August, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 43078 of 2024
 Smt. Saroj Sharma
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Amit Kumar Goswami - Advocate for the petitio
 Shri V P S Tomar P L appearing on behalf of Advoca
 Shri Ravinder Singh Kushwah, learned counsel for t
 2].
 Order

This application has been filed by the applicant under Section 439(2) of Cr.P.C. for cancellation of bail granted to the respondent no.2/accused, whose bail application M.Cr.C. No.8511/2014 was allowed by this Court on 1.10.2014 in connection with Crime No.149/2012 registered at Police Station Hazira, District Gwalior (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 365,
364 (A), 120B, 302 of IPC and 11/13 of M.P.D.V.P.K. Act.

2. Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the present application has been filed on the ground that in order to obtain bail in the present case, the respondent no.2 prepared fake and fabricated documents of Prem Kumar alias Chunna Sharma and presented it before the learned Trial Court and this Court and got bail on the basis of forged documents and when the applicant NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:17921 2 MCRC-43078-2024 came to know about this, she lodged an FIR at Crime No.6/2014 under sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B IPC in Police Station Dehat Bhind.
A charge-sheet was filed in the matter and vide order dated 5.7.2024 in S.T.No.15/2019 he had been convicted against which Cr.A.No.7829/2024 is pending before this Court
, thus, it is submitted that it has been found that respondent no.2 had got the bail by placing forged documents and does not deserve to remain on bail.

sentences.text: 3. Prayer is not opposed by the respondent/State.

4. On due consideration, and on perusal of the record, this Court is inclined to allow the present application as the respondent no.2 has clearly misused the liberty extended to him by this Court and does not deserve to remain on bail.

5. Accordingly, the order dated 1.10.2014 passed in M.Cr.C.No.8511/2014 is hereby recalled and the bail bonds furnished by the respondent no.2 are hereby cancelled, and the respondent no.2 is directed to surrender before the Trial Court within one month, if he is not in jail.

6. Accordingly, M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
(MILIND RAMESH PHADKE) JUDGE (aspr)
